prs.location:
Capital Dock Residence is part of a unique urban quarter that captures the culture, history and cosmopolitan pulse of Dublin. Located alongside the River Liffey, River Dodder and Grand Canal Dock this waterfront location provides easy access on foot, by bike, by car or public transport to the City and its surroundings.
 
If you like to stay local, enjoy your morning coffee and delicious healthy lunches within Capital Dock at The Art of Coffee, Fresh The Good Food Market and Nutri Green. Catch up with friends for a casual evening in BrewDog or treat yourself to a meal in Allta, one of Dublin finest restaurants. St. Stephen Green is accessible in 15 minutes and the neighbouring villages like Sandymount, three kilometers away, give you a stunning beach for morning jogs and a choice of great eateries. 
Each amenity is on the grounds of Capital Dock. Three Locks Square is where you can socialise with neighbours at regular events. If you are up for some water sports, try windsurfing or paddle boarding with Surfdock next door.
prs.aboutDevelopment: Founded in 1977, Kennedy Wilson is a global real estate investment company.  We own, operate and invest in real estate both on our own and through our investment management platform.  We focus on residential for rent, also called private rented sector (PRS) and office properties located in Ireland, the UK and Western US.  Kennedy Wilson is significantly invested in the Irish property market, operating and developing a portfolio of high-quality commercial assets and stylishly-finished apartments to rent in prime Dublin locations.

description:
Capital Dock Residence offers Dublin's most unique rental opportunity in Ireland's tallest landmark property with spectacular city and seascape views of Dublin.
 
Capital Dock Residence offers luxury apartments to rent in a waterfront location in Dublin's Docklands. There are a selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, including spectacular penthouse units. 

Residents enjoy community living in five-star luxury, combining an unparalleled standard of urban living. There is broad range of exclusive on-site services and the dedicated concierge team is on hand to accommodate the diverse wishes of today's modern lifestyle. Amenities include a business lounge with meeting rooms, fully equipped gym with complementary fitness classes, chef's kitchen and dining room, cinema, games room and lounges.
